steps.content: Holding the strange notes you discovered hidden behind the door, you and Ignis return to the street.
The street is as busy as ever, and yet among the hustle and bustle, you can't help but notice several new faces—probably recent spectators blending into the crowd, each embracing their unique "part."

steps.speaker: The Bell
steps.content: Dong... Dong... Dong... Dong...
Four deep bell tolls resonate from overhead, signaling to you that time is ticking closer to Luvia Ray's much-awaited press conference.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We're on the clock; locating Luvia is crucial. Only then can we unravel the next twist in this unfolding narrative.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Without that, we're stuck as mere extras, missing out on the central storyline.
You piece together all the notes you've gathered and they lead to a specific location. Glancing upwards, you indeed spot a hidden alley, veiled by a swath of drapery.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Is it possible... that Luvia's here?
You look at the clue in your hand, a hint of concern etching your brow.
Something feels off. In the rooms you just checked, there were many "performers," with even a few Sinners among them.
Strangely, their behavior is entirely uncharacteristic. Are they perhaps "playing their parts too convincingly"?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Chief... I've got this nagging feeling that something isn't right.
Ignis looks out onto the street, her brow furrowed, seemingly picking up on something amiss.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Didn't we have a crowd of "spectators" around us when we first got here?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: They're gone now, and it's like every person we see has become a "performer," playing a role, whether we're aware of it or not...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Also, in the first act, sometimes the audience members who were on stage forgot that they were performing.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Right, back then, you didn't even need to look at what they were wearing to tell who had abruptly joined the performance.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: But now...
Watching the busy streets, the set here is incredibly authentic. Each person appears to be truly living their life, engaging in shopping, leisure, arguments...
However, the more lifelike it becomes, the stronger the sense of disconnect you both feel.
You feel like aliens, invaders, as if you don't fit into this world.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is this what Lady Pearl meant by "the extraordinary, incomparable theater"? Where each person gets to pick the life they've always wanted to live?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Where everyone can find the most fitting role for themselves?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Yet, there's something off about this play... it's unnerving...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Could it be we're still searching for our destined parts? What happens if we end up never finding them?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Could we... could we end up just like before, being chas...
No, that's impossible.
What if all the spectators become the performers? Who's left to witness this extraordinary play?
Ignis, anxiously nibbling her lip, receives a reassuring pat on the shoulder from you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't worry, you're not alone in this. I'm still just a spectator without a script, too.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Any problems arise, I'll protect you.
Seeing you arch an eyebrow trying to look cool, Ignis huffs and averts her face.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I-I don't need your protection. I'm the Sinner here; it's obvious that I should be the one watching out for you!
Although Ignis tries to look calm, her ears, however, now reddening beneath her fiery hair, give away her secret thoughts.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Relax, it's unlikely anything will go wrong. And if we're worried about losing our way in the script, we've always got Luvia to turn to!
You flick the notes in your hand and start walking in the direction written on them with Ignis.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Luvia is the star Lady Pearl handpicked herself. Find her, and we'll have the playbook for what comes next. What's there to worry about?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Everything will be fine.
Led by the clue, you take the side stairs up into a larger stage area.
Near the door concealed by curtains, you're suddenly greeted by voices coming from inside.
Yes, what have we done wrong？
Let's just stick to that line, no matter who it is.
Following the voices, you reach a building. As you're about to open the door, a familiar voice echoes from within.
Mr. Reporter will handle everything on our behalf.
And Mr. Lawyer, he'll be keeping an eye out for us in secret.
A reporter and a lawyer?
Sound effect of door opening
Opening the door, a wave of soft music flows out. There, in the heart of the hall, on an opulent seat, is Luvia Ray poised elegantly.
Surrounding her are several people you've encountered before.
They appear to be engrossed in a conversation, oblivious to your entry.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I'll sort everything out with them.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: As your leader now, it's my duty to keep you safe.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Fear not, friends, you have me... I'm not the same person I once was. I'm no longer a pushover.
Luvia Ray speaks with such conviction that it sparks a wave of cheers.
Surrounded by admirers, the spotlight shines on her wherever she goes. This level of confidence is new to you, as is the stunning acting talent she's now revealing.
It's almost like you're seeing a stranger.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Umm... Luvia?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Or perhaps... Ray?
You tentatively call out to Luvia Ray. She swiftly turns her attention to you and Ignis.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Oh? You two? Have you got the interview questions prepared yet?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What interview questions?
You and Ignis share a look of confusion, slightly at a loss.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Can I steal you away for a quick chat, if that's okay? We really need your help at the moment.
Luvia Ray gazes at you with a perplexed tilt of her head but still makes her way over.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: If you're stumped with the writing, just consult Mr. Reporter. He brought you two along as assistants out of goodwill, after all.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Getting to work on big news stories as an assistant? That's a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So, are we supposed to tag along with Mr. Reporter next? But...
Luvia Ray interrupts you, gesturing to the reporter engrossed in his work.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: If you're nervous, just stick to the questions Mr. Reporter wrote.
Luvia Ray grabs a pile of papers from the desk, handing them over to you and Ignis.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: "Have you got enough clothes over at Fortuna?"

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: "Have you got enough food over at Fortuna?"

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Try to have a tearful look when you ask questions, okay? You guys can pull that off, can't you?

Luvia Ray strides back and forth before you, her expression full of tactical calculations, her hands orchestrating the air as if she is gearing up not for a press meeting but for a do-or-die showdown.
So, we're expected to put on an act? You think to yourself.

Watching Luvia, you can't help but notice how effortlessly natural she appears, looking at you as though you're just part of the cast, lacking any trace of her earlier appeals for cheers while dancing.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Well... acting isn't exactly our forte, you know. Just fill us in on what's supposed to happen next.
You grab the sheets from Ignis, handing them back over to Luvia Ray.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Yeah, we'll just be the audience and watch you guys do your thing!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I know you all have been nailing your roles.
The moment you respond, you instantly feel the whole hall's ambiance taking a tense turn.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Roles...? You think this is all just an act?
Luvia Ray looked at you, her eyes flashing with a threatening intensity.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I'm the one in charge here, their guardian hero, the one who'll guide them to freedom!
A hush falls, and you observe Luvia Ray's face gradually growing more somber.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: ...And you think I'm just putting on a show?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I... That's what you've been doing, right...?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're Luvia, aren't you...? My... Sin...

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I don't recognize you! Aren't you the reporter's assistant? My friends? What are you talking about?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: You're an intruder! You don't belong here!
Suddenly, the shackles in your consciousness clench tight, a sharp pain striking fiercely. In haste, you shove Ignis aside.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: You're the intruder of this world!!
Lightning crashes down, just like it did in the jailbreak!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hold on... Luvia, that was you using your special power?!

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: You have that "everything" I'm looking for... in the star of this show...

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: This is my ability... I'm the heroine, chosen by the story itself!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I won't let you interfere!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Luvia! What... Have you forgotten who we are?!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Wipe them out!!
Luvia raises her arm, calling to action, and the culprits echo her call passionately.

steps.speaker: Culprit A
steps.content: They're not our allies!

steps.speaker: Culprit B
steps.content: They're here to take our freedom!

steps.speaker: Culprit C
steps.content: We mustn't let them prevail!!
The lights begin to flash wildly, blinding those who don't know the stage well. All that can be heard are the angry shouts and footsteps.
The sounds of footsteps become more chaotic, with more people charging at you. In an instant, you and Ignis are separated—

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: ${PlayerName}!! Watch out!!!

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I'll protect my people... No one's harming them on my watch!
Instant chaos erupts, "performers" brandishing "props," with Luvia Ray commanding the lightning.
Furniture falls over, a mysterious wind buffets you, all driven by a shared intent to "overcome" you, converging on your position.
You dodge and weave, seeking Ignis, but your gaze finds only Luvia Ray, regally seated in her throne-like chair.
She's orchestrating everyone's actions, clearly determined to scatter you.
In her distant eyes, you sees clearly—she's the star of the show, not your Sinner.
Something's off with this theater, with this storyline...
